trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ بَدَاۗئِعَهُ بِقُدْرَتِهٖ وَمَلَكَ الْاُمُوْرَ بِعِزَّتِهٖ وَعَدَلَ فَلَا يَجُوْرُ وَاَنْصَفَ فَلَا يَحِيْفُ وَكَيْفَ يَجُوْرُ وَيَحِيْفُ عَلٰى مَنْ سَمَّاهُ بِالضَّعْفِ وَقَرَعَهُ بِالْفَقْرِ وَنَبَّهَهُ عَلَى الْغِنَاۗءِ الْاَكْبَرِ مِنْ رِضْوَانِهٖ وَدَعَاهُ اِلَى الْحَظِّ الْاَوْفَرِ مِنْ غُفْرَانِهٖ وَاَشْرَعَ لَهٗ اِلٰى ذٰلِكَ السَّبِيْلَ وَاَمَرَهٗ اَن يَّلِجَهَا بِصَالِحِ الْعَمَلِ لَمْ يُتَّهَمْ بِالشَّقْوَةِ مَنْ اَمَرَ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَبِالْجَوْرِ عَلَى الْعَبِيْدِ بَلْ اَوْجَبَ الْعِقَابَ عَلٰى فَاسِقِهِمْ وَالثَّوَابَ لِمَنْ نَهَاهُمْ مَنْ هُوَ اَشْفَقُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ اُمِّ الْفُرُوْخِ عَلٰى فَرْخِهَا تَعَالَى اللهُ عَمَّا يَقُوْلُ الظَّالِمُوْنَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيْرًا۔

lines.rarabic: AL-HAMDO LILLAA-HIL LAZEE KHALAQA BADAA-E-A’HO BE-QUDRATE-HI WA MALA-KAL OMOO-RA BE-I’Z-ZATE-HI WA A’DALA FALAA YAJOO-RO WA AN-SAFA FALAA YAHEE-FO WA KAIY-FA YAJOO-RO WA YAHEE-FO A’LAA MAN SAMMAA-HO BIZ-ZA’FE WA QARA-A’HO BIL-FAQRE WA NABBA-HAHO A’LAL GHENAA-IL AKBARE MIN RIZ-WAANE-HI WA DA-A’A-HO ILAL HAZZIL AW-FARE MIN GHUF-RAANE-HI WA ASHRA-A’ LAHU ILAA ZAALE-KAS SABEE-LA WA AMARA-HU AIY-YALE-JAHAA BE-SAALE-HIL A’MALE LAM YUTTA-HAM BISH-SHAQ-WATE MIN AMARA BIR-RAHMATE WA BIL-JAWRE A’LAL A’BEE-DE BAL AWJA-BAL E’QAABA A’LAA FAASE-QE-HIM WAS-SAWAABA LEMAN NAHAA HUM MAN HOWA ASH-FAQO A’LAIY-HIM MIN UMMIL FOROO-KHE A’LAA FARKHE-HAA TA-A’A-LAL LAAHO A’MMAA YAQOO-LUZ ZAALE-MOONA O’LOO-WAN KABEE-RAN.

trans.en: Praise be to God, Who created His New Phenomenon by His Power, Ruled the affairs with His Might, Did Justice without oppression, was Fair and did not incline away from fairness. How could He oppress or be unfair to one whom He has called weak and poor, and has made him aware of his greatest need being His Pleasure, and has invited to enjoy the most from His Forgiveness, has paved the way to walk on this Path and has ordered us to do so with good deeds? No. He cannot be accused of tyranny since He has ordered to have mercy, promised the servants punishment for oppression, chastisement for committing sins and reward for those who admonish against it. He is even kinder to them than a bird is to its newborns! God is Sublime and indeed He is exalted above what the evil-doers say! Exalted and Great (beyond measure)!
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ صَوَّمَنِيْ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ وَمَنْ فَرَقُهٗ بِمَا يُوَرِّطُنِيْ فِيْ اَلِيْمِ الْعَذَابِ فِيْخَلِّصْنِيْ (يُخَلِّصُنِيْ) مِنَ الْعِقَابِ بِصِيَامٍ وَاجَبَ (اَوْجَبَ) لِيَ الثَّوَابَ بِصِيَامٍ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ عَلٰى اَنْ هَدَانِيْ وَعَافَانِيْ وَكَفَانِيْ كَمَا يَسْتَحِقُّ الْجَوَادُ الْكَرِيْمُ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ (وَصَلَّى اللهُ) صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلٰى اَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا۔

lines.rarabic: SUBHAANA MAN SAWWA-MANEE A’NIT TA-A’A-ME WASH-SHARAA-BE WA MAN FARAQO-HU BE-MAA YO-WARRE-TONEE FEE ALEE-MIL A’ZAABE FEE-KHALLIS-NEE (YO-KHALLE-SONEE) MINAL E’QAABE BE-SEYAA-MIN WAA-JABA (AW-JABA) LE-YAS-SAWAABA BE-SEYAA-MIN LAHUL HAMDO LILLAAHE A’LAA AN HADAA-NEE WA A’A-FAANEE KAMAA YASTA-HIQQUL JAWAA-DUL KAREEMO YAA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEENA (WA SALLAL LAAHO) SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA A’LAA AHLE BAIY-TE-HIT TAIYYE-BEE-NAT TAAHE-REENA WA SALLIM TASLEE-MAN KASEE-RAN.

trans.en: Glory be to Him who made me fast by abstaining from food and drinks so that He may save me from the march of painful torture and released me from Chastisement with the reward He granted me for the obligatory fast. Praise be to God who guided me, gave me well-being and took care of me as it best fits the Generous the Benevolent. O the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful. Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s) the Immaculate, the pure ones and may His peace be on them plentifully.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
